final_text:
Done in one execution.

`out/T5/solution.py` loads the two base shards and the adapter, pairs `lora_A`/`lora_B` by prefix, strips the `base_model.model.` PEFT prefix to get the base name, and applies `w += (alpha/r) * B @ A` in float32 with no transpose (asserting `fan_in_fan_out` is false rather than assuming it). All four required checks run before any write: 32 pairs merged, no `lora_` names, `model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight` still `[2048, 2048]`, 114 tensors.

Output: 114 tensors greedily packed in sorted-name order into 10 shards, each within 512 MiB (an oversized single tensor would be flushed alone), plus `model.safetensors.index.json` with a full `weight_map` and `total_size` 5,119,148,032 — matching the base index total.

Two notes on the task text: `adapter_config.json` lists `target_modules` as `["q_proj", "v_proj"]`, not the dotted form quoted in TASK.md, so I derived base names from the adapter keys instead; and the 412 MB tensors are actually below the 512 MiB cap, so the "stored alone" clause never triggers here. Self-report is in `out/T5/REPORT.md`.
